configuration_unit: One provider-route/semantic profile; native catalogue metadata is data, not percoin strategy knobs.
canonical_instrument: nativeID/family/base/quote/settle catalogue binding retained in provenance
price_tick/quantity_step when qualified, unknown not guessed
producer_row_binding_requirements: Shared response identity/digest and row/native market key join exactly to canonical instrument. A ticker-only join is insufficient.
One response can yield many separate instrument facts; global200/lastUpdate does not assign freshness or coverage to every row.
assertInput rejects a declared foreign instrument_id. It cannot detect a wrong payload falsely relabeled with the expected ID; SOURCE qualification must prove native row binding.
Provider native venue/family/market identity must remain truthful. Do not turn other-venue OHLC/OI/funding into a BingX fact by renaming it.
Bulk trade-ID and position-ID dedup namespaces include upstream provider+market; wrappers share upstream lineage/cache/quota.
clock_requirements: Real source event/asof/known timestamps per fact/row/window, received transport time separate; event<=received<=analysis and original expiry/TTL.
Cache hit reuses original event/received/expiry; no renewal from a fresh cache read.
A provider-wide timestamp applies to every row only with explicit documented semantics. Missing source clock stays unqualified.
Keep exact interval/window start/end, closure/grid/completeness and currency/unit period; funding next settlement is not rate-known time.

matrix_to_fact_envelope.VERIFIED_ACTUAL: USABLE only while actual value/semantics/clocks are valid; otherwise STALE or other exact typed status
matrix_to_fact_envelope.UNKNOWN: Keep UNKNOWN in coverage matrix; consumer gets nonusable NOT_CHECKED with exact identity/unit/clock reason. ABSENT only when actual field absence is established. Never0 or verified.
matrix_to_fact_envelope.UNSUPPORTED_EXPLICIT: ABSENT with exact scoped evidence/reason, not asset exclusion
matrix_to_fact_envelope.BUDGET_DEFERRED: NOT_CHECKED with budget reason; map may use NOT_CHECKED_BUDGET

coverage_layers.note: Owner coverage-matrix vocabulary is not identical to FACT_STATUSES; normalizer maps it, not passing UNKNOWN/VERIFIED_ACTUAL verbatim to createFact.

architecture_limits: BC verifies consumer format and common engine, not new provider API capabilities, free entitlement, pagination completeness, cache deployment or550actual coverage.
Live frozen production policy admits BINGX/TELEGRAM; F588 preparation inactive. SOURCEF589/ROOT separately qualify and admit new provider bulk.
Current today bank/pricing/caps/spentunknowns and3manual/future/delivery/outcomes protection are unchanged.
BA queue proposal is separate; not an actual DOOD/KIMCHI refusal cause.
reason_no_case: No new analytical consumer-format defect established beyond existing documented producer-identity/semantics trust boundary and pending source proof.

factory_and_usability_distinction.unknown_placeholders_allowed: ABSENT/NOT_CHECKED may retain null value/unit/event/expiry; do not make them USABLE by filling defaults.
factory_and_usability_distinction.consumer_qualified_checks: USABLE requires actual value and qualified kind-specific unit/origin/identity/clock/coverage. Many extra native-source proof fields are verified by producer, not independently rediscovered by pure analytics.
